Background: ECOSOC set up the Commission on Human Rights to draft a declaration, a covenant and measures of implementation; the Commission sent ECOSOC its draft declaration; the General Assembly referred the item to the Third Committee on 24 September 1948.

The Third Committee's work: it took up only the declaration, spent 84 meetings on it (records A/C.3/SR.88-116, 119-170 and 174-178), set up a Sub-Committee on arrangement and style, and adopted the draft declaration (text A) at its 174th-178th meetings.
The draft resolutions B to E and the meetings that adopted them: petition (160th), minorities (163rd), publicity (178th), covenant and implementation (178th).
The recommendation of the five texts to the General Assembly; it is the opening words of seq 8, whose other text is the preamble.
